note_en: 越来越 + adjective means "more and more": 风格越来越大胆，人气也越来越高 "her style grew bolder and bolder, and her popularity kept rising." English changes the adjective itself (bolder, higher) or adds "more and more," but in Chinese the adjective stays in its plain form and 越来越 simply goes in front of it, with no 很 added.
